feature_basis: Manufacturer text plus native inspection of the listed manufacturer images. Features are comparison evidence, not individually exclusive identifiers.
decision_rules: A feature hidden, blurred or outside the frame is unobserved; it cannot contradict a family.
Compare body layout, controls and readable identifiers before using colour or interchangeable accessories.
These negative examples are not an exhaustive non-catalogue universe.
Reference images contain no test photograph, test label or test-case identifier.

dyson_big_ball.name: Dyson Big Ball

sources.title: Dyson Big Ball corded vacuum
sources.supporting_passage: Rides on a ball, to steer easily around corners and into difficult places.

visible_features: A separate floor-standing spherical wheeled canister, with a transparent bin and cyclone assembly above the ball; compare the hose connection and canister outline.
A flexible hose connects the canister to a separate wand and cleaner head.
variant_limits: A detached mattress, combination or floor tool is an accessory; its presence does not establish another machine.
Ball-shaped canisters also occur in other Dyson cylinder ranges; these references do not prove every cylinder variant belongs to this catalogue family.

dyson_v8_absolute.name: Dyson V8 Absolute family

sources.title: Dyson V8 Absolute vacuum cleaner
sources.supporting_passage: The motor and battery are positioned around the handle, creating the optimum centre of gravity for floor-to-ceiling cleaning.

sources.title: Choose your Dyson V8 support
sources.supporting_passage: The top of this filter is light purple and translucent.

sources.title: Dyson V8 SV10 operating manual, page 20
sources.supporting_passage: pull the red lever back and lift upwards to release the cyclone.

visible_features: The referenced V8 has its transparent bin below the cyclone assembly; compare this perpendicular bin/body layout against the in-line V12, V15 and V11 bodies.
The SV10 manual documents a red lever lifted to empty the bin, and a finger trigger. Inspect the lever region directly before claiming it is absent.
Dyson lists star-filter and pinch-handle-filter V8 variants; a light-purple translucent top filter is documented.
variant_limits: Filter shape, filter colour, wand colour and bundled heads vary. Do not reject V8 because a cap differs from the current India reference.
The V8 family overlaps visually with earlier Dyson cordless models. A visible red lever or purple cap alone is not an exclusive identifier.
The Hair screw tool is supplied with multiple families, including the current V8; an accessory-only image cannot identify V8 by that tool.

visible_features: An in-line transparent bin ahead of the motor/cyclones and rear circular LCD. The manufacturer comparison specifies trigger operation.
Compare the trigger/handle and fuller bin proportions against V12; confirm the relevant region is visible.
variant_limits: An LCD screen by itself does not distinguish V15 from V11, V12 or Gen5detect.
Illuminated soft-roller heads and Hair screw tools are shared across families. A cleaner-head-only photo may lack family evidence.

dyson_v16_piston_animal.name: Dyson V16 Piston Animal

sources.title: Dyson V16 Piston Animal cordless vacuum
sources.supporting_passage:
New dual conical cleaner head
New compressing bin
LCD screen for instant feedback

visible_features: The All Floor Cones Sense head has two conical rollers. Compare both rollers and the centre of the head with the supplied detail image.
The motor/bin body has a CleanCompaktor compression mechanism and rear LCD; compare the body silhouette and handle with the manufacturer side view.
variant_limits: The supplied matte-black/copper colourway is an example, not a colour-only identity rule.
This product is also supplied with a Fluffy Optic head, so lack of the dual-cone head cannot exclude V16.
The manufacturer says its intelligent attachments are not interchangeable with other current Dyson vacuums; do not transfer older accessory compatibility to V16.
Compression capacity, motor power and filtration performance cannot be established from a store photo.

dyson_wash_g1.name: Dyson WashG1
visible_features: A long loop handle above a low body containing water tanks, with a broad rectangular two-roller cleaning head.
Compare the front/side tank layout, handle bend and roller head with the supplied manufacturer views.
variant_limits: This is a wet floor cleaner. A generic upright wet-cleaner silhouette alone does not identify this family.
Water tanks or rollers outside the frame are unobserved, not absent.
The supplied blue/black finish is an example; colour alone must not decide identity.

dyson_v11.name: Dyson V11, non-catalogue lookalike

sources.title: Dyson V11 cordless vacuum cleaner for business
sources.supporting_passage: The motor, bin, and cyclone are aligned

visible_features: An in-line transparent bin and motor/cyclone body, finger trigger and rear display; compare the complete body against V15.
The referenced V11 LCD shows runtime and modes; an LCD alone does not distinguish it from V15.
variant_limits: V11 variants include differing display/control implementations. A single reference is not exhaustive.
Absence of a dust-particle graph in a switched-off or unreadable display does not establish V11.

sources.title: Dyson Gen5detect and Gen5outsize launch
sources.supporting_passage: Hidden inside the wand is a built-in dusting and crevice tool

visible_features: An in-line transparent bin and larger motor/filter body with rear circular LCD and single-button power control.
The manufacturer describes a handle comfort pad and a built-in dusting/crevice tool exposed when the wand is removed; compare these only where visible.
variant_limits: Gen5detect shares a rear LCD, illuminated head and Hair screw tool with other Dyson families.
Both iron/purple and blue/copper variants exist. These references cannot make filter colour an invariant.
A button alone does not distinguish Gen5detect from V12; inspect body/handle proportions and any readable machine identifier.

shark_stratos.name: Shark Stratos cordless family, non-catalogue lookalike

sources.title: Shark Stratos IZ400UK cordless vacuum
sources.supporting_passage: Shark Stratos Anti Hair Wrap Plus Cordless Vacuum

visible_features: The official IZ400UK reference shows an elongated dark handheld body, visible Shark wordmark, stick wand and broad floor nozzle; compare its housing shape with Dyson cyclone bodies.
Use a readable Shark name on the actual machine as brand evidence, while checking its association with that object.
variant_limits: The manufacturer image is UK IZ400UK; US IZ862H and other Stratos variants can differ in finish and attachments.
This negative represents the Stratos family, not every Shark model. An unreadable brand name is not evidence that it is absent.
A generic head or narrow partial wand alone does not identify Shark or rule out Dyson.
